name: 11978 · W Hampton Bch, NY
findings: ZIP 11978 (W Hampton Bch) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11978 (W Hampton Bch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11978 (W Hampton Bch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
